posts.caption: That dark whisper telling you you're broken? It's not the truth. It's just noise. Most people believe every thought in their head is a fact — but you are not your thoughts. You're the one who notices them. Next time one shows up: notice it, name it, let it move on. The more you fight it, the louder it gets. 💭 Save this for the next time your mind lies to you. #MentalHealthAwareness #IntrusiveThoughts #Mindfulness
